title: GENESIS plug-in receipt (Einklinken E1)
description: What a guest returns for one packet, alongside their pull request. Reuses the actor{type,id} and ref{id,sha256,path} shapes from maker-handshake/schemas/genesis.event.v1.schema.json (vendored verbatim from PhoenixAddictionary/memoria-mcp@81a79ce; not itself modified) - extended here with a 'guest' actor type that schema does not define, because a receipt is a new kind of actor speaking, not a genesis.event.v1 envelope. No one grades their own work: verifierOutput must be the command's real, verbatim output; self-judgments belong in claims, marked as unverified, never folded into verifierOutput.

headCommit.description: The exact commit a reviewer should check out to see what the receipt describes.

verifyCommand.description: Must equal the packet's own verifyCommand - a receipt does not get to grade itself against an easier bar.

verifierOutput.description: Verbatim stdout+stderr of verifyCommand. Not a summary.

id.description: <vendor-or-platform>/<handle>, e.g. github/octocat - never a name presented as this project's own maintainer or bahn.

claims.description: Self-reported statements the verifier did not check (e.g. 'also fixes #12'). Read as evidence to verify, never as a verdict.

evidence.description: Optional pointers to additional artifacts (screenshots, logs) using the same id/sha256/path shape as genesis.event.v1 refs.

x-genesis-rules.description: Cross-field rules the stdlib validator enforces.
rules: verifyCommand must equal the referenced packet's verifyCommand exactly.

verifierExitCode 0 is required for a receipt to be eligible for MERGED (a nonzero exit is not itself a schema error - it is recorded, and CI on the PR is the second, independent run of the same command).
actor.id may not equal any known maintainer or bahn identity - a guest never presents as this project's own voice.
